jobs.title: Creative Strategist (YouTube Ads)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a **creative strategist** who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive e-commerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.

  

* 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook

* A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
* Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
* The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
* Proven spend behind your work - creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
* Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer & AI Video Creator
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a creative and innovative Graphic Designer & AI Video Creator to develop high-quality visual content for digital marketing, social media, branding, and promotional campaigns. The ideal candidate should have strong graphic design skills and practical experience using AI-powered tools to create engaging videos, animations, and marketing visuals.

Key Responsibilities

* Design creative graphics, social media posts, advertisements, brochures, flyers, and marketing materials.
* Create professional promotional videos, reels, and short-form content using AI video-generation tools.
* Develop AI-generated videos, animations, and visual concepts for marketing campaigns.
* Create and edit video content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms.
* Develop visual concepts in line with the company's brand identity and guidelines.
* Use AI tools to generate images, videos, voiceovers, and creative marketing content.
* Edit videos, add transitions, subtitles, sound effects, and background music.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative campaigns and content ideas.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Proven experience in graphic design and video creation.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro or equivalent software.
* Experience with AI tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Kling AI, Pika, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of AI video generation, image generation, and video editing techniques.
* Strong understanding of social media content formats and digital marketing requirements.
* Creative thinking, attention to detail, and good time-management skills.
* A portfolio demonstrating graphic design work and AI-generated videos.
* Stay updated with the latest graphic design trends, AI technologies, and video creation tools.

Pay: AED1,700.00 - AED2,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Creative Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Creative Strategy AnalystCreative Strategy Analyst, Advisors Creative Desk  
  
Overview  
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty, and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally.  
The Advisors Creative Desk sits within Services as a full-service creative and advertising capability, helping clients build and grow their brands through end-to-end solutions, from brand positioning and strategy to creative development, campaigns, and content.  
  
The Creative Strategy Analyst supports the development of data-driven brand and communication strategies across a portfolio of brands, translating consumer, cultural, and market insights into clear strategic recommendations. Working closely with creative teams and clients, the role contributes to strategic thinking through research, analysis, insight development, and project support across multiple briefs and categories.  
  
Role  
As a Creative Strategy Analyst, you will:  

* Support the development of brand, creative, and communication strategies for clients, drawing on consumer, cultural, category, and market insights.
* Contribute to the development of strategic and creative briefs, presentations, and client deliverables.
* Conduct research using primary and secondary sources to identify trends, audience behaviours, competitive dynamics, and strategic opportunities.
* Analyze research findings and help translate insights into clear strategic recommendations.
* Stay informed of marketing, consumer, creative, and media trends to ensure strategies remain relevant, impactful, and culturally resonant.
* Participate in creative ideation sessions for larger client projects of strategic importance.
* Manage multiple briefs and projects simultaneously.

  
All About You  

* Several years of experience in strategy, planning, brand strategy, communications planning, or consumer insight roles, preferably within advertising, branding, creative, or consulting agencies.
* Experience supporting the development of brand and communication strategies across a variety of clients and categories.
* Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into strategic recommendations.
* Understanding of consumer behavior, market research, cultural trends, and competitive analysis.
* Experience contributing to campaign planning and integrated marketing initiatives across digital, social, CRM, and traditional channels.
* Strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly and concisely.
* Excellent problem-solving and conceptual thinking abilities.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple priorities.
* Strong collaboration skills and experience working within cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Psychology, Sociology, or a related field.
* Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus, with Arabic considered an advantage.
* Open to occasional travel as required.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
